title: The Sessions page's sticky header is live

owner_note.text: The Sessions page now has one sticky row: Today ▾, a search box, and Filters ▾, which holds everything else. On a phone the first session card starts at about 205 px from the top instead of 417. The old layout is still reachable from Filters → Old layout. The short cards (title, cost, child sessions, state) are being built now.
